text: Ok so, this is the configurable page in the CopilotKit docs, for LangGraph TypeScript. And I have implemented this page in my project. So, the TypeScript tab here only shows a direct graph invoke, with a context and a recursion limit. But umm, it doesn't show how to pass that context when CopilotKit runs the graph, through the LangGraph agent and the LangGraph server, which is the setup the quickstart builds. So there's no way to actually use this from the docs, in a CopilotKit app. Also, uh, the language tabs default to Python, even on the TypeScript track, so you land on Python code first, and have to switch every time. So yeah, the TypeScript side here is basically incomplete. That's it for this one, kindly look into this issue.
